CustomField.description: Flags the captured shelf price as Over / Under / At the RSP.
CustomField.formula: IF(OR(ISBLANK(Shelf_Selling_Price__c), ISBLANK(RSP_Snapshot__c), RSP_Snapshot__c = 0), "", IF(Shelf_Selling_Price__c > RSP_Snapshot__c, "Over RSP", IF(Shelf_Selling_Price__c < RSP_Snapshot__c, "Under RSP", "At RSP")))
CustomField.label: Price Compliance
